name: agent-aquarium
description: A Claude Mod (function-hooks plugin): /aquarium draws the session as a fish tank in a pane with kitty graphics — the main loop is the parent fish, each subagent a baby that is born and swims off, and every tool call an animation (Read feeds, Edit nests, Bash dashes, an error sinks); the water level follows the context window. Half-block fallback where the terminal shows no images. / Claude Mod（function hooks プラグイン）。/aquarium でセッションを Kitty graphics の水槽として pane に描画。メインループが親魚、サブエージェントは誕生して泳ぎ去る稚魚、ツール呼び出しは魚の動き（Read で餌、Edit で巣、Bash でダッシュ、エラーで沈む）、水位はコンテキスト使用率に連動。画像非対応端末では半ブロック描画に自動切替。

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How often the tank is redrawn (2-20). Lower it if the terminal stutters; /aquarium fps N changes it for the session.
